$Comment: Present Thieves in the snow, day and night, while Christmas runs, written as the world-spawn rule
Christmas_Present_Thieves_Snow when Christmas starts and stilled (every moon phase at zero) when it
ends. They come in ones and twos onto soil and snow in the third zone's tundra and forests at any
hour, so a player who lives in the cold finds them in daylight too.
The body is read by the game's own NPC/Spawn/World codec, the shape of its own rules. The game allows
one rule per creature and environment: the thieves' night rule
(Christmas_Present_Thief_Night_Spawns.json) names only the first zone's environments, so the two never
share one. To make the snow busier or quieter, change Weight.
